title: Narcissism in America: The Smithsonian Exhibit Proposal
description:
Narcissism in America entered a museum-policy debate when Forbes reported on October 7, 2026, that a House Democrat proposed a Smithsonian exhibit on Trump's “authoritarian narcissism.” This video examines the reported proposal and its political framing, without treating that characterization as a clinical diagnosis. The supplied report describes a proposal, not an approved exhibit. Should a U.S. history museum use the term “narcissism” in an exhibit about a president, or focus on documented actions?

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
